verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list Web as a supported platform, and its examples are compiled to WASM and run in the browser on WebGL. That covers the "runs in the browser, WebGL today" core of the story. Nothing in the pack addresses payload or binary size, and WebGPU is never mentioned, so half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of a reasonable WASM payload size, a documented WebGPU backend or roadmap, and independent hands-on reports of shipping browser builds.
